rewritten_query:
WITH cs_ui AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
     AND cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash + cr.cr_reversed_charge + cr.cr_store_credit)
),
cross_sales AS (
    SELECT i.i_product_name AS product_name,
           i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
           s.s_store_name AS store_name,
           s.s_zip AS store_zip,
           ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
           ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
           ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
           ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
           ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
           ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
           ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
           ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
           d1.d_year AS syear,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           SUM(ss.ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
           SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS s2,
           SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store_returns sr
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
     AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN cs_ui
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3
      ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1
      ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2
      ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p
      ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd1
      ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2
      ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad1
      ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad2
      ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
    JOIN income_band ib1
      ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN income_band ib2
      ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d1.d_year IN (1999, 2000)
      AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 1 AND 11
      AND p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
      AND p.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
      AND p.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
      AND ad2.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'OH')
      AND cd1.cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D')
      AND cd1.cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
      AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D')
      AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
      AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
    GROUP BY i.i_product_name,
             i.i_item_sk,
             s.s_store_name,
             s.s_zip,
             ad1.ca_street_number,
             ad1.ca_street_name,
             ad1.ca_city,
             ad1.ca_zip,
             ad2.ca_street_number,
             ad2.ca_street_name,
             ad2.ca_city,
             ad2.ca_zip,
             d1.d_year,
             d2.d_year,
             d3.d_year
)
SELECT cs1.product_name,
       cs1.store_name,
       cs1.store_zip,
       cs1.b_street_number,
       cs1.b_street_name,
       cs1.b_city,
       cs1.b_zip,
       cs1.c_street_number,
       cs1.c_street_name,
       cs1.c_city,
       cs1.c_zip,
       cs1.syear,
       cs1.cnt,
       cs1.s1 AS s11,
       cs1.s2 AS s21,
       cs1.s3 AS s31,
       cs2.s1 AS s12,
       cs2.s2 AS s22,
       cs2.s3 AS s32,
       cs2.syear,
       cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales cs1
JOIN cross_sales cs2
  ON cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk
 AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name
 AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip
 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt
WHERE cs1.syear = 1999
  AND cs2.syear = 2000
ORDER BY cs1.product_name,
         cs1.store_name,
         cs2.cnt,
         cs1.s1,
         cs2.s1;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Simplify duplicate values in IN lists: ('W','W','D') -> ('W','D'), ('College','4 yr Degree','College') -> ('College','4 yr Degree'); constant fold `i_current_price BETWEEN 1 AND 1+10` to `BETWEEN 1 AND 11`, and `cs2.syear = 1999+1` to `cs2.syear = 2000`.
The `cs_ui` CTE is used once, so it is inlined by the planner; remove its unused output columns (`sale`, `refund`) and keep only `cs_item_sk`, since only the HAVING-filtered item key is consumed.

Push `d1.d_year IN (1999, 2000)` into the `cross_sales` CTE. The CTE was aggregating all years, but the outer query only uses syear=1999 and syear=2000; with ~73k date rows and ~28.8M store_sales rows this dramatically reduces aggregation input. Also remove unused CTE output columns `fsyear` and `s2year` from the SELECT list (they must remain in GROUP BY to preserve aggregation granularity).
Rewrite comma-style joins into explicit ANSI INNER JOINs; keep `cross_sales` as a (implicitly materialized) CTE because it is referenced twice, avoiding recomputation of the large aggregation.
Fold `1 + 10` to `11` and `1999 + 1` to `2000` so the optimizer sees literal range/year predicates directly.
